LanguageData.HelicopterParenting_EnableFloorDrawFixTo: Validate floor-drawing spots against safer indoor temperatures.
LanguageData.HelicopterParenting_EnableNatureRunFixTo: Validate nature-running targets against edge and threat safety rules.
LanguageData.HelicopterParenting_EnableSkyDreamFixToo: Validate or replace unsafe sky-dreaming spots, and stop active sky dreaming if a predator enters the configured buffer.
LanguageData.HelicopterParenting_AvoidPredatorsToolti: Nature running rejects outdoor spots, and sky dreaming rejects or interrupts them, when a wild or hostile predator is within the configured radius.
LanguageData.HelicopterParenting_RejectDuringThreatsT: Disable nature running and sky dreaming during active hostile threats.
LanguageData.HelicopterParenting_EnableDiagnosticsToo: Write troubleshooting messages when Helicopter Parenting redirects, cancels, or interrupts child learning jobs. Off by default.
